methods.label: Calculate the products, add, then double
methods.explanation: Calculate the three products inside the parentheses first: \(5\times4=20\), \(5\times3=15\), and \(4\times3=12\). Their sum is \(20+15+12=47\); multiplying by 2 gives \(47\times2=94\).
